name: const unsafe fn align_of_val_raw < T : ? Sized > (val : * const T) -> usize
rule: If T has a trait-object unsized tail, calling align_of_val_raw(val) requires the size of the entire value, including the dynamic tail and statically sized prefix, to fit in isize.
api: const unsafe fn align_of_val_raw < T : ? Sized > (val : * const T) -> usize
